analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold but remains at 56.0 in neutral territory. MACD histogram shows improvement but stays negative and is slowing. Volume ratio at 0.85 indicates contraction. Price is consolidating within the 5-day range, lacking clear direction. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive session.
